title: 05 approval receipt, https://use05.dev/approval/v0
description: An in-toto Statement v1 saying a person approved or rejected an intent (subject: the intent card digest) or an outcome (subject: the exact tree). Fields are only ever added, as optional ones.

scope.description: An intent approval is bound to the intent card; an outcome approval to the exact tree.

intent_sha256.description: Digest of the intent card the decision was made against (always present for intent approvals).

hotfix.description: Only on an approval of a hotfix's outcome: the environment it lands on. Only such an approval, for that environment and task, counts for landing the hotfix.

policy_sha256.description: Digest of the effective policy at the time. A policy change makes the approval stale.
